title: Returns of Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders: Authorization, Windows and Refunds
content:
A return of Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders merchandise is authorized against one order line before the item comes back.

## 1. Conditions for authorizing a return

1.1 **Completed order.** The order status is completed when the return is authorized. The status is read from the order's record in the system before the authorization, for the order the line belongs to.

1.2 **Return window.** A return is accepted only if it is authorized no later than the item category's return window after the order's completed date. The window is counted in calendar days from the completed date, that date being day 0, using:
- the item category's return window for changed-mind and not-as-described returns;
- the opened-food guarantee days for satisfaction-guarantee (quality guarantee) returns;
- the defective-return window for defective returns.
Where the holiday return extension applies, the later of the two dates is the last day. A request on the last day is in time.

1.3 **Non-returnable items.** Items in a category with a 0-day window, and final-sale items unless the method makes final-sale items returnable, are returnable only as defective.

1.4 **Units.** The units already refunded or credited on the line, plus the units returned, do not exceed the line's quantity. Units already refunded or credited are the units of the return refunds and damage credits already booked against that line.

1.5 **Return method.** The return method must be one of the method's allowed ways of return.

## 2. Conditions for refunding a return

2.1 A return is refunded only if the returned item is received with the return authorization in status authorized and no later than the method's return authorization validity after the date the return was authorized (requested date). The validity is counted in calendar days from the requested date, that date being day 0; an item received on the last day is in time.

## 3. Amount and destination of the refund

3.1 **Refund basis (retired).** Formerly: the refund is each returned unit's price paid after its allocated coupon and certificate times the units returned. This clause is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis for refunds on returns.

3.2 **Deductions (in force).** On changed-mind returns only, the following are withheld: the method's mail return label fee for a mail label (waived for an active Tailwise Plus tier where the method provides the waiver), the method's freight pickup fee for a freight pickup, and the method's restocking share of an opened large item. Reasons in the method's fee-waived list - damaged, defective, wrong item and not as described - carry no deduction.

3.3 **Fulfillment fee on an all-error return (retired).** Formerly: the fulfillment fee is refunded only when every line is returned for a Tailwise error and the method provides for it. This clause is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis for fulfillment fee refunds.

3.4 **Destination.** Refunds go to the method's refund destination, the original payment.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates and windows)

| Case | Judgement |
|---|---|
| Completed date is day 0; a hypothetical 30-day window; authorized on day 30 | In time (the last day counts) |
| Same window; authorized on day 31 | Not accepted |
| Order placed 10 December, completed 14 December; hypothetical 30-day window ends 13 January; holiday extension date 31 January | Last day is 31 January, the later date |
| Same order with a hypothetical 60-day window ending 12 February | Last day is 12 February, the later date |
| Authorized on day 0 with a hypothetical 14-day validity; item received on day 14 | In time |
| Same; item received on day 15 | Not refunded |
| Line of 4 units, 1 already credited for damage; 3 returned | Allowed (1 plus 3 is 4) |
| Same line; 4 returned | Not allowed (1 plus 4 exceeds 4) |

superseded_clauses: The refund is each returned unit's price paid after its allocated coupon and certificate (refund_price_basis) times the units returned
The fulfillment fee is refunded only when every line is returned for a Tailwise error and shipping_refund_on_error_return is true.
